title: Mainsah et al. 2025 — bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset (Study O)
description: This dataset is Study O of bigP3BCI, an open P300-based brain-computer interface collection, and contains EEG recordings from 18 participants with ALS. Participants used a 9x8 character grid speller with a supervised checkerboard stimulus paradigm across two sessions per subject. Target and non-target flashes are annotated with HED tags, and the data are formatted for machine learning and benchmarking with MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) from 32 channels at 256 Hz using a standard 10-20 montage, in a laboratory with a 60 Hz line frequency. Participants used a P300 speller with online feedback, and calibration was followed by testing. Events are Target and NonTarget, epoched over a 0-1.0 s interval.
